crossRefs.note: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.
For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three…
What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;
yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word…
But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.
A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees, and spread them on the…
Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to…
But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ…
They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us.…

translations.web: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
translations.bsb: From that time on many of His disciples turned back and no longer walked with Him.
translations.kjv: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
translations.asv: Upon this many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
